name: legal-agency-suite
description: A print-first (WeasyPrint) MOU / Engagement Letter / Schedules A-E document template family — the most readable-register of the three legal-document families (11.5pt/1.5 line-height, Tinos webfont), uniform 1in margins.

variants.name: proposal-letter
variants.description: Logo letterhead (inline SVG), sender address block, non-binding notice.

variants.name: mou-engagement-letter
variants.description: Text letterhead, addressee block, RE line, salutation.

variants.name: body-clauses
variants.description: Parties/recitals section, decimal <ol> clause numbering, indented sub-clauses.

variants.name: alloc-fee-table
variants.description: Allocation/fee table — 0.75pt cells, surface-tint header fill, subtotal/total rows.

variants.name: signature-block
variants.description: Table-based signature block (Word-export-safe layout), approved-connector notation.

variants.name: schedule-cover
variants.description: Page-break schedule cover pages, per-schedule named counters (apage...epage).

variants.name: drafting-notes
variants.description: Internal change-log page — intended as a removable final page before distribution, not part of the executed document.

aria: Clause numbering uses real <ol> (not visual-only numerals) so assistive tech can announce clause position. Signature block uses <table> only for print/Word-export layout fidelity — semantic role="presentation" where the table conveys no relational data.
motion: Print-first static document — no interaction states; renders to PDF via WeasyPrint.
open_questions: oq-1: em-dash convention — this family uses the \2014 escape; subscription-agreement mandates a literal UTF-8 em-dash. Reconcile before any shared draft-stamp component is built.

oq-2: the pdf-home-button marker geometry referenced in the source draft is a tool-contract with tool-pdf-interactive.py (see interactive-pdf-binder component), not a token or recipe concern of this component.
